item.text: Inspecting the reconstructed 10-K JSON for the registrant contact line, then I’ll return the exact telephone number only.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMCOR_2023_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
for i,x in enumerate(data.get('texts',[])[:80]):
    t=x.get('text','')
    if any(k in t.lower() for k in ['telephone','phone','tel','registrant']):
        print(i, x.get('page_no'), repr(t[:500]))
PY"
